title: Conformance scenario
description: A sequence of tool calls with what each returned in @pixerate/editor, for another implementation to replay (domains/<domain>/fixtures/<id>.json).

id.description: Unique within the domain; also the file name.

setup.description: Options for the fresh editor the scenario starts from, such as { width, height }.

skip.description: Why an implementation skips the whole scenario, by implementation (swift).

arguments.description: Tool arguments; a string @n stands for the id numbered n.

reload.description: Before this call, save the document and open the save again (history cleared), as an app reopening the painting does; expect.loaded records what loading reported.

load.description: Before this call, open this saved document (the editor's own save format, assets inline); expect.loaded records what loading reported.

document.description: Also compare the saved document after this call.

render.description: Also compare the render data after this call (what the canvases draw, for editors without pixels: the vector scene).

pixels.description: Also compare the rendered pixels after this call.

paper.description: false leaves the paper out (transparent where unpainted).

ignore.description: JSON pointers left out of the result before comparing; a * segment is every element or member.

result.description: The normalized structuredContent, or { error: { code, message, details? } }.

loaded.description: What opening the document reported (steps with reload or load): the normalized problems, or { error } when the document was refused.
